 Rey Mysterio Suspended From AAA In Storyline, Accused Of Having Affair With Marisela Peña 
 Andrew Thompson November 7, 2026, 11:11 pm 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Bluesky 
 A major accusation was thrown at Rey Mysterio and Marisela Peña.
 Week three of Lucha Libre AAA’s Héroes Inmortales featured the AAA Hall of Fame induction of the company’s matriarch, Marisela Peña. Inducting her into the Hall of Fame was AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio.
 Showing up during the induction was Peña’s son, Dorian Roldán. Roldán stated that he filed complaints about Mysterio with the Higher Authority of Lucha Libre, and among the things he filed was noting that Mysterio sent AAA talents to unsafe working conditions in the USA, which led to them getting hurt. He cited El Hijo del Vikingo and Mini Vikingo as examples .
 Roldán brought up Rey striking Omos at AAA Ola de Calor, where Omos attended as a fan because he had been suspended from AAA by Mysterio. He then mentioned that Rey inserted himself as the referee for the main event of Triplemanía 34, which saw El Grande Americano defeat Dominik Mysterio to become the AAA Mega Champion.
 Lastly, Roldán questioned why his own mother, Marisela, gave Rey the AAA General Manager job over him and why she chose him to induct her over her own son. He then stated that he has proof that Rey has been having an extramarital affair and sleeping with Marisela.
